source.text: 2. 除SetPolicy、CheckPersistPolicy接口外，其余接口调用者需具有ohos.permission.FILE_ACCESS_PERSIST权限，权限定义详见[access_token](https://gitee.com/openharmony/security_access_token)仓

norm.limitation: The README describes other interfaces generally; async delegation and exceptions require independent review.

review.applicabilityRationale: IDL declares UnSetPolicy and UnSetPolicyAsync; the service async implementation directly delegates the same arguments to UnSetPolicy. README says all interfaces other than SetPolicy and CheckPersistPolicy require FILE_ACCESS_PERSIST.
review.rationale: The README general rule includes UnSetPolicy, but its use table omits that method; this approval is a Builder-LLM interpretation of the documented contract, not independent human or device evidence. Check caller and permission behavior separately before a finding.
